subject: Post-call: Novapulse security checklist, SOC 2 Type II ask & portal access
messages:
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Alice Jarvis <alice.jarvis@novapulse.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 13:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call: Novapulse security checklist, SOC 2 Type II ask & portal access

Hi Alice — thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap and clear next steps so we have alignment.

Call highlights:
- Novapulse is evaluating inference for PII-enriched clinical summarization (HIPAA scope).
- Primary concerns: SOC 2 Type II evidence, data residency controls, and audit logs for model inference.
- Timeline: procurement decision target by end of Q3; security review must complete first.

Action items (owner / ETA):
1) Novapulse: confirm any additional compliance constraints beyond HIPAA/GDPR (Alice) — by 6/22
2) Redwood: provide SOC 2 Type II report (redacted) and bridge letter; provide trust portal access for evidence exchange (Karthik) — by 6/21
3) Mutual: kick off a short vendor security questionnaire (DDQ) to capture environment specifics (we attached a starter file).

Attached: Novapulse_DDQ_v1.xlsx (starter questionnaire).

I routed Jordan (solutions engineering) into the thread to support any technical evidence requests; Monica will coordinate legal/procurement logistics if we move to a reserved capacity contract.

Next step: I will provision a Trust Portal request for you and attach the SOC 2 Type II request form (internal routing). Once you accept the portal invite, you can upload any vendor forms or we’ll drop the report there.

If anything above is off, flag it and I’ll adjust. Otherwise I’ll send the portal invite and SOC 2 request by end of day.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
karthik.iyer@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0197
Redwood Inference

Date: Tue, 20 Jun 2028 16:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-call: Novapulse security checklist, SOC 2 Type II ask & portal access

Karthik — thanks for the recap and clear plan. A couple quick clarifications from our side:

1) Scope: HIPAA + EU data exports (we have a small EU patient pilot) — so we need confirmation of GDPR alignment and data residency options.
2) Primary ask: Our InfoSec lead (security@novapulse.com) needs a copy of your most recent SOC 2 Type II and a bridge letter that covers the period since that report.
3) If possible, can you share what artifacts you typically make available in the Trust Portal (e.g., config docs, network diagrams, audit logs)?

We reviewed the DDQ and filled the first tab with environment details; attaching our version. Also looping in our security mailbox for the formal SOC2 intake.

We are on a tight schedule — provisioning the portal invite this week would be huge.

Thanks,
Alice Jarvis
Director of Product, Novapulse
alice.jarvis@novapulse.com | (212) 555-0112

Subject: Re: Post-call: Novapulse security checklist, SOC 2 Type II ask & portal access

Hi Alice / Novapulse security team —

Thanks for the quick turnaround and the filled DDQ. We can absolutely support HIPAA and GDPR controls; our SOC 2 Type II covers security and availability for the most recent 12-month window.

What I’m doing now (today):
- Created a Trust Portal request: https://trust.redwood.ai/portal/novapulse-request-7843 — please accept using the email security@novapulse.com. The portal will contain a redacted copy of the SOC 2 Type II, a bridge letter template, and a checklist of commonly requested artifacts (network diagram, IAM / key management summary, encryption at rest/in transit, audit log retention).
- Uploaded a SOC2_Request_Form.pdf (internal route form we use to package redaction notes).
- Requested expedited review from our compliance team to prepare a bridge letter scoped to the period requested. Monica is copied to help with any contract/PO needs if we need to expand data residency options.

If your security mailbox accepts the portal invite, I’ll add Jordan as the technical contact so he can upload baseline config docs and an anonymized network diagram. If you’d prefer SFTP, we can set that as a fallback (note in the portal acceptance form).

Attachments: SOC2_Request_Form.pdf (application/pdf)

I’ll follow up once the bridge letter is ready and when the SOC 2 redacted package is live in the portal.

Best,
Karthik

Hi Karthik —

Portal invite received and accepted. We uploaded the completed vendor intake and added a note requesting the redacted SOC 2 and bridge letter be shared inside the portal.

Quick notes from our intake reviewer:
- Please include a short summary of your data residency options and whether any processing happens in shared multi-tenant GPU pools versus isolated instances.
- We’ll need clarity on audit log retention periods and whether per-tenant logs can be exported for 12 months.

Thanks — looking forward to the SOC 2 package.

Regards,
